notes.title: Update Notes for April 9th 2023
notes.content:
- Yakohama and Favela environments from the [url=https://www.unrealengine.com/marketplace/en-US/product/city-environment-megapack-vol]City Environment Megapack Vol. 2 [/url] on the Epic Games Store added to the city level

- General fixes

notes.title: Patch notes April 8th 2023
notes.content:
- Fixed splashscreen so it can be skipped but it does not happen automatically anymore

- Improved accessibility of controls menu 

- More passwords

notes.title: Patch notes for April 7th
notes.content:
- Fixed the texture of the rewind effect

- Switched the chat model from DaVinci to ChatGPT 3.5 Turbo 

- Added a barebones controls menu accessible by pressing P while in the open world.

- General dynamic sky improvements.

notes.title: Patch notes for April 7th 2023
notes.content:
- Added ability to skip splashscreen by pressing any keys twice.

- Changed the main menu a little bit. There is no longer a Load Game option because it didn't work. Instead players can go directly into the main open world and skip the backstory quiz cutscene. If player wants to see the cutscene they have to say "How did I get here?" to the AI in the shack.

- Added more passwords. Working on GPT-3.5 Turbo support for the AI.

notes.title: Update Notes for April 6th
notes.content:
- Changed the sky  to be more dynamic

- New sky made the level look different so the materials used in the desert scene are different now. Still working on getting that exact right look

- Need to add a functioning Load Game system

notes.title: Update notes for April 1st
notes.content:
- More passwords

- General bug fixes (it's still got bugs just different ones!)

- New HUD

notes.title: Update Notes for April 1st
notes.content: - Patched the mountains so they are walkable and no longer a backdrop.

notes.title: Update Notes for March 31st 2023
notes.content:
- Improved collision with Anta in the shack so that dialogue doesn't get spammed when you get near.

- Added dripping crystal effect after discovering powers to any character build that is a male Epic Human.

- Removed borders to the map so it is possible to fall off. Planning to expand the map
